reason: The hypothesis synthesizes three distinct methodological components—active learning of ML potentials, covariance-based vibrational entropy, and GPR-assisted thermodynamic integration—into a single workflow for fusion free energies of high-entropy alloys, a combination not proposed or demonstrated in any passage. It targets a specific gap (cost of free energy for multicomponent systems) by integrating techniques from separate domains (vibrational entropy from P1/P43, ML free energy from P7/P10, GPR from P13/P25) and applies them to a new regime (high-temperature melting of HEAs) with a falsifiable benchmark.
